about.title: Where Beauty Finds Its Beat
about.story: Nestled in Shop no.41 of ICB Flora, Rhythm Hair & Beauty Care has become Gota's sanctuary for authentic beauty transformations. We believe every person carries their own unique rhythm, and our role is to help you express it through expertly crafted hair and beauty services. With 280 clients trusting us with their beauty journey, we've learned that true elegance comes from understanding each individual's personal style.

items.question: How do I book an appointment at your Gota location?
items.answer: Simply call us at 063536 99709 or visit us at Shop no.41, ICB Flora. We recommend booking in advance to secure your preferred time slot.

items.question: What should I expect during my first visit to Rhythm Hair & Beauty Care?
items.answer: We begin with a personal consultation to understand your style preferences, hair type, and beauty goals. This helps us create a customized experience just for you.

items.question: Do you offer bridal and special occasion packages?
items.answer: Yes, we specialize in bridal makeup and styling. We offer complete packages including hair, makeup, and beauty treatments to make your special day unforgettable.

items.question: How long do typical hair color treatments take?
items.answer: Color services typically range from 2-4 hours depending on the complexity of your desired look. We'll provide an accurate time estimate during your consultation.

items.question: What hair and beauty products do you use?
items.answer: We carefully select premium professional products that are gentle yet effective. Our team can recommend the best products for your specific hair and skin type.

items.question: Is parking available near your ICB Flora location?
items.answer: Yes, ICB Flora provides convenient parking facilities. We're easily accessible from S.G. Highway, making your visit comfortable and stress-free.
